newsitem.title: USA: Spectratek to run telecomms satellite.
newsitem.headline: Spectratek to run telecomms satellite.

text.p: Spectratek Inc said Tuesday that it has entered into an agreement in principle to manage a telecommunications satellite through its wholly owned subsidiary, Teltran International Inc.
The agreement is scheduled to be closed before the end of September 1997 and is subject to certain conditions, it said.
The company said it estimates net profits from the management contract to average approximately $20 million a year after an 18-month startup period, based upon information provided to it.
It said the transaction requires Spectratek to reverse split its shares by 20 to one, resulting in a reduction in outstanding shares from approximately 18,311,000 to 915,500 shares.
It will also be required to issue 17.5 million shares in exchange for the management contract, it said.
